summary: Iteration 91 — tested GDPR endpoints, Polar checkout, Polar webhook, plus frontend smoke (legal/pricing/kids-gate/account/keeper rooms). 9/9 status-code-level pytest checks passed (8 parametrised Polar-checkout integration tests skipped because Polar API returns 422). Found 2 critical backend bugs blocking real Polar checkout — one fixed (user.id → user.user_id), one outstanding (Polar API schema mismatch + guest-email rejected). Frontend: legal page, pricing consumer-rights, kids age gate, /account unauth redirect all PASS. RoomConvaiChat disclosure verified at source-level only — panel did not mount during anonymous room visits, so runtime render not confirmed. /account authenticated UI not verified due to navigation timeout (intermittent).

critical.issue: After fixing user.id→user.user_id, Polar /v1/checkouts/ now returns 422 with TWO problems: (a) guest emails 'guest-*@guest.aurin.local' rejected by Polar email validator ('aurin.local is a special-use/reserved name'). Either omit customer_email for guests or use a non-routable but valid domain (e.g. example.com / a real placeholder); (b) Polar expects a top-level 'product_id' field (singular) — current body only sends 'products': [pid]. checkout.py services/checkout.py line 59 needs to also send 'product_id': product_id (or switch entirely depending on Polar's current contract). End result: NO checkout can succeed today.
Code referenced `user.id` but the User pydantic model has `user_id` (no id field). Every call returned 500/'polar_error' before reaching Polar. FIXED in this iteration (server.py line ~16372).

minor.issue: Errors bubble up as HTTP 502 'polar_error: <full Polar error>' — leaks Polar's internal validation message to the client. Consider logging the detail and returning a sanitised 502 'checkout_provider_error'.

integration_issues.issue: Visiting /clarity-release (→/grace/room), /body-room (→/body-world), /parents-room, /course-room as a fresh guest did NOT mount [data-testid='convai-panel'], so [data-testid='convai-ai-disclosure'] could not be verified at runtime. Source inspection confirms the disclosure is correctly nested inside RoomConvaiChat just below the start-session button (line 970 of RoomConvaiChat.jsx) — it WILL render whenever convai-panel does. Main agent should verify by walking through the actual room-entry flow (consent + threshold + paywall) to ensure panel mounts.

Could not load /account with a guest session in Playwright — page.goto timed out at 20s on 'networkidle'. Likely a long-poll or slow first-paint. Backend export/delete endpoints work via direct API calls. data-testid coverage on the Account page therefore NOT verified at runtime.

action_items: Update /app/backend/services/checkout.py to (a) skip customer_email for guest@guest.aurin.local or use a real-looking placeholder domain, and (b) include 'product_id': product_id in the Polar /checkouts/ body (current Polar API schema rejects 'products' array alone and requires the singular field).
After fixing checkout.py, re-run the 8 parametrised SKU tests (test_checkout_session_returns_polar_url) — they currently skip on 502.

Make the keeper-room flow self-mount the convai-panel for a fresh guest session, OR add a tiny 'preview' route that mounts RoomConvaiChat alone for QA. As-is, K1 disclosure cannot be verified without manual end-to-end interaction.
Investigate the /account page slow load (>20s) — likely a blocking fetch on mount.
(Optional, polish) Sanitise the polar_error bubbling: don't echo Polar's internal email-validation message verbatim to the client.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:16355 — billing_create_checkout used user.id but User has user_id (mismatch). Fixed.
services/checkout.py:59 — body uses {'products': [pid]} but Polar's current API also requires top-level 'product_id'. The integration was clearly never end-to-end smoke-tested against live Polar.
services/checkout.py:69 — customer_email passed unconditionally; guest sessions have synthetic @guest.aurin.local emails that Polar rejects. Need a guard.
server.py is now 17,275 lines — far beyond the 700-line guideline. Split GDPR + Polar + auth + room logic into routers.

success_rate.backend: 100% on status-code contracts (9/9 ran, 8 skipped on Polar 502). Real Polar checkout = 0% (broken).
success_rate.frontend: 80% (Legal, Pricing consumer-rights, Kids age gate, /account unauth redirect, LAUNCH_PAUSE soft CTAs all verified. Convai disclosure verified at source-only; /account auth UI not loaded in time).

The 8 SKU parametrised tests currently skip on 502 — once checkout.py is fixed to send product_id and to skip @guest.aurin.local emails, they should return real Polar URLs. 2) Convai disclosure runtime check needs a way to mount RoomConvaiChat without going through the full room-entry flow. 3) /account page load is slow — increase timeout to 30s + 'domcontentloaded' instead of 'networkidle'.
rca of the issue: Polar checkout has been broken since at least the iteration that added the new SKU ladder: (a) the endpoint accessed a non-existent user.id attribute (fixed here); (b) the Polar API contract used in checkout.py expects 'product_id' (singular) at the top level and a real-looking customer_email — neither holds in the current code. Reproduce: POST /api/billing/checkout/session with a guest session and any new SKU → 502 'polar_error: Polar checkout creation failed: 422 …'. Mitigation already partially applied; remaining work outlined in action_items.
